authority: Local source-free method research while the next map route remains unselected; no real source or new method is approved.
retained_failure_findings: The first disposable probe incorrectly required JP2OpenJPEG as the default reader; ArcGIS's installed GDAL selected JP2KAK. An open GDAL dataset also prevented Windows temporary-directory cleanup on that failure path.

The second probe called AutoIdentifyEPSG on the reopened JP2 spatial reference; it raised Unsupported SRS because the synthetic JP2 retained equivalent UTM coordinates without an embedded EPSG authority code. Its open handle also prevented cleanup.

The initial reversible-only synthetic three-band mask fixture lost an isolated 1 under JP2OpenJPEG's default quality setting. QUALITY=100 and YCC=NO preserved the fixture in both installed readers. This is a fixture-generation result, not evidence about Copernicus mask encoding.
